Name: Josabad the Gederathite
Summary: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Gederathite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:4: One of those who came to David at Ziklag, called the Gederathite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Josabad in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
